s1.title: 1. Acceptance of these terms
s1.body: is a web application for learning to read Chinese through graded texts. Its core features are free to use; an optional paid PREMIUM subscription unlocks higher usage limits. By creating an account or using the site, you agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree with them, please do not use ChineseReads.

s2.title: 2. The service
s2.item1: Read graded HSK texts with word-by-word pinyin and translations (audio requires a free account).
s2.item2: Save words into personal vocabulary collections and study them as flashcards.
s2.item3: Create your own texts from typed text or from images (OCR).
s2.item4: Listen to text, sentences and words with text-to-speech audio.

s3.title: 3. Your account
s3.body: You are responsible for keeping your password safe and for all activity under your account. Please provide accurate information when you register. You must be old enough to consent to the processing of your personal data in your country (in the EU, generally 16, or the age set by your member state).

s4.title: 4. Acceptable use
s4.item1: Use the service for any unlawful purpose or in breach of these terms.
s4.item2: Upload content that is illegal or infringes the rights of others.
s4.item3: Attempt to break, overload or gain unauthorized access to the service or its infrastructure.
s4.item4: Abuse the AI, OCR or audio features, for example through automated or mass requests.
s4.item5: Resell or redistribute the service without permission.

s5.title: 5. Your content
s5.body: The texts and images you upload remain yours. They are kept private to your account, and you grant ChineseReads only the permission needed to process and display them back to you — including sending them to the third-party AI, OCR and speech providers listed in the Privacy Policy. You are responsible for having the right to upload whatever you submit.

s6.title: 6. Intellectual property
s6.body: The ChineseReads name, design, code and curated graded texts belong to their creator and are protected by law. You may use them only for your personal, non-commercial language learning.

s7.title: 7. Third-party services and privacy
s7.body: ChineseReads relies on third-party providers for AI generation, OCR and audio, and processes your personal data as described in our

payments.title: 8. Subscriptions and payments
payments.intro: ChineseReads offers optional paid PREMIUM subscription plans that raise your usage limits. If you subscribe, the following terms apply:
payments.item1: Plans are billed on a recurring basis (monthly or yearly) at the prices shown on the pricing page, in euros. Any applicable taxes are shown or added at checkout.
payments.item2: Payments are handled by Stripe, our payment provider. ChineseReads never receives or stores your full card details — they are processed directly by Stripe. See the Privacy Policy for how payment data is handled.
payments.item3: Subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each billing period, charged to your payment method on file, until you cancel.
payments.item4: You can cancel at any time from the billing portal ("Manage subscription"). Your premium access stays active until the end of the period already paid and is simply not renewed afterwards.
payments.item5: Consumers in the EU/EEA normally have a 14-day right of withdrawal for online purchases. Because premium features are digital content made available to you immediately, by subscribing you expressly request immediate access and acknowledge that you lose this right of withdrawal once your premium access has started.
payments.item6: Except where the law requires otherwise, payments for a period that has already started are non-refundable. If you believe you were charged in error, contact us at the address below.
payments.item7: We may change the plans, their prices or their limits. Changes apply to future billing periods and, where legally required, you will be notified in advance.

s8.title: 9. Availability and changes to the service
s8.body: The service is provided "as is", without warranties of any kind beyond those that cannot be excluded by law. Free and premium features, usage limits and availability may change or be interrupted at any time (paid subscriptions are governed by the section above). AI-generated translations and descriptions may contain errors and should not be relied upon as professional translation.

s9.title: 10. Limitation of liability
s9.body: To the extent permitted by law, the creator of ChineseReads is not liable for any indirect or incidental damages arising from your use of the service. We may suspend or delete accounts that break these terms. You can delete your own account at any time from your profile.

s1.title: 1. Who we are
s1.body: is a web application for learning Mandarin Chinese through graded texts and vocabulary tools. This service is operated as a personal project.

s2.title: 2. What data we collect
s2.intro: We collect the following personal data when you register:
s2.name: Name
s2.password: Password (stored encrypted using BCrypt — we never store plain passwords)
s2.payment: If you subscribe to PREMIUM: billing identifiers that link your account to your subscription (a Stripe customer ID and subscription ID). Your card details are entered directly on Stripe and are never stored by ChineseReads.
s2.analytics: We also collect anonymous usage data through Google Analytics (only with your consent), including pages visited, time on site, and general device/browser information. IP addresses are anonymized before being sent to Google.

s3.title: 3. How we use your data
s3.item1: To provide and maintain the ChineseReads service.
s3.item2: To manage your account and personalize your experience.
s3.item3: To analyze usage patterns and improve the application (only with consent).
s3.note: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes.

s4.title: 4. Cookies
s4.intro: We use the following types of cookies:
s4.essentialBody: necessary for authentication (JWT token stored in HttpOnly cookie). These cannot be disabled as the service cannot function without them.
s4.analyticsBody: used by Google Analytics to collect anonymous traffic data. These are only set after you give your explicit consent.
s4.withdraw: You can withdraw your consent at any time by clearing your browser cookies or contacting us at the email address below.

s5.title: 5. Third-party services
s5.intro: ChineseReads uses the following third-party services:
s5.stripe: to process subscription payments securely. Your card and payment details are handled by Stripe as the payment processor; ChineseReads does not receive or store full card numbers.
s5.deepseek: to generate Chinese learning texts and to power the AI tutor (asking about words and context). Only the text you send is processed, no account or personal data.
s5.vision: to extract text from uploaded images. Images are processed and not stored.
s5.tts: to generate audio pronunciation of Chinese text, words and sentences. Only the Chinese text to be read aloud is sent, no personal data. Audio is generated on demand and not stored.

s6.title: 6. Data retention
s6.body: Account data is retained as long as your account is active. You can request deletion of your account and all associated data at any time by contacting us. Analytics data is retained for 26 months as per Google Analytics default settings. Records related to payments and subscriptions may be kept for longer where necessary to comply with tax, accounting and anti-fraud obligations.
